verses.text: Ayik 27 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, hata' ix schael yich winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Amasías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 52 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jecolías sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Azarías chi' wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Amasías smam winh.
Palta a juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima, ix snhusanpax inkienso heb' ta'.

Ix yak'och jun yab'il skuch lepra Jehová t'a winh rey chi' masanto ix cham winh. Yuj chi', majxo ajlaj winh rey chi' t'a spalakio, ch'ok patil b'aj ix ajek' winh. Haxo winhaj Jotam, winh yuninal winh, ha' winh ix och yilumalok spalakio winh chi', ix yak'anpax yajalil winh t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Azarías yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj rey David t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, haxo winhaj Jotam winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 38 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, wake' ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Haxo winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Jabes ix och ajk'olal t'a winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winhaj Zacarías chi', ix smilancham winh winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zacarías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, ayik yalannak to a heb' yinhtilal winh, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal chi'.
Ha winhaj Salum chi', ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, palta junnhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Haxo winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi ix kot yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Tirsa, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a chonhab' Tifsa. Ix smilancham masanil heb' anima heb' winh ta' yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en Tifsa chi'. Ix tekjielta yol sk'ol heb' ix yab'ix yuj heb' winh. Masanil tas ay ta', ix yik'b'at heb' winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' winh yujto maj chajioch heb' winh yuj heb' aj chonhab' chi' t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Manahem chi' t'a Samaria yak' owal yet' winhaj Salum chi'. Ayik ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Salum chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Salum chi' yet' tas ix aj yoch winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Zacarías, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 10 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak b'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Manahem reyal chi',
ix jawi winhaj Pul sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a Israel chi'. Yuj chi' 750 kintal k'een plata ix yak' winh t'a winhaj Pul chi' yik tz'och winh yet' winh yik wach' skannhej winh t'a yopisio.

Ix yak'och 50 siklo k'een plata winhaj Manahem chi' t'a yib'anh junjun heb' b'eyum t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi', yik syal stupan k'een tumin syak' winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smeltzaj winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a schonhab', majxo ochlaj waan winh t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manahem yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi' ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Pekaía winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 50 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Pekaía yuninal winhaj Manahem reyal t'a Israel. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Palta a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yajal heb' winh soldado winhaj Pekaía chi', ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Pekaía chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a 50 heb' winak aj Galaad yet' winh. Ix miljicham winhaj Pekaía chi' yuj heb' winh t'a skuartel t'a yol spalakio t'a Samaria yet' winhaj Argob yet' winhaj Arie. Haxo winhaj Peka chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Pekaía chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik 52 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel. 20 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Peka reyal t'a Israel chi', hata' ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' tik yuj winh: Haton Ijón, Abel-bet-maaka, Janoa, Cedes, Hazor, Galaad, Galilea yet' masanil yol yik Neftalí. Masanil heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' icha preso t'a Asiria chi'.

Ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, a winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías chi', ix smilancham winhaj Peka chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Peka yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik schab'il ab'il yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Azarías smam winh.
Ix sb'o'okh spuertail stemplo Jehová winh t'a yib'anh, palta a juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan inkienso heb' ta'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jotam yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix och ijan Jehová yak'ankot winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yak' owal yet' Judá chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jotam chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David, winh smam yicham winh. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
